Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Baca Tabel IO
io <- read.csv("C:/Users/dbodro/OneDrive - CIFOR-ICRAF/dw/ICRAF/analisis data/CIFOR-ICRAF indonesia/Solusi/Jawa Tengah/0_Regional Ekonomi/R - Regional Ekonomi Jateng/IO BUKECAP.csv", 
               header=T,
               sep=",",
               stringsAsFactors = F)
# baca tabel TK per sektor 
tkSektor_prov <-  read.csv("C:/Users/dbodro/OneDrive - CIFOR-ICRAF/dw/ICRAF/analisis data/CIFOR-ICRAF indonesia/Solusi/Jawa Tengah/0_Regional Ekonomi/R - Regional Ekonomi Jateng/Estimasi Tenaga Kerja 2025.csv", 
                           header=T,
                           sep=",",
                           stringsAsFactors = F) 

pdrb_bukecap <- read.csv("C:/Users/dbodro/OneDrive - CIFOR-ICRAF/dw/ICRAF/analisis data/CIFOR-ICRAF indonesia/Solusi/Jawa Tengah/0_Regional Ekonomi/R - Regional Ekonomi Jateng/PDRB ADHK BUKECAP.csv", 
               header=T,
               sep=",",
               stringsAsFactors = F)

# Penyesuaian nama Input kolom yang dibutuhkan
jml_sektor <- 66
kolom_Sektor <- paste0("X", 1:66) # Membuat daftar nama kolom x1, x2, ..., x66 secara otomatis
namaSektor <- as.vector(io[1:jml_sektor,"Nama.Sektor"])
kolom_FD <- paste0("X309")
kolom_TOutput <- "X700"
baris_totInput <- 74
baris_totInputPrimer <- 73
baris_pjkProduk <- 68



# pembacaan matrix A
matrixA <- io %>%
  slice(1:jml_sektor) %>%       # Mengambil baris 1 hingga 66
  select(kolom_Sektor)        # Mengambil rentang kolom dari x1 sampai x66

Z_prov <- data.matrix(matrixA)

total_input_antara <- colSums(Z_prov) #total input antara
total_input_primer <- io[baris_totInputPrimer,kolom_Sektor] #total input primer
total_input <- io[baris_totInput,kolom_Sektor] #total input primer

# Total Output Sektor di Provinsi (X_prov)
X_prov <- as.numeric(io[74,kolom_Sektor])
X_prov[is.nan(X_prov)] <- 0 #jika Nan diganti 0 

# Matriks Koefisien Teknis Provinsi (A_prov = Z_prov / X_prov)
A_prov <- sweep(Z_prov, 2, X_prov, FUN = "/")
A_prov[is.nan(A_prov)] <- 0 #jika Nan diganti 0 

# Menciptakan matriks identitas (I) berukuran n x n
nA_prov <- nrow(A_prov)
matrixI <- diag(nA_prov)

# Menghitung (I - A) dan mencari Invers Leontief: (I - A)^(-1)
I_minus_A <- matrixI - A_prov
Leontief_Inverse <- solve(I_minus_A)
sum(colSums(Leontief_Inverse))


#kolom final demand
fd <- io[1:jml_sektor,kolom_FD]

#Perkalian Matriks: (I - A)^-1 %*% FD
# Menggunakan operator %*% untuk perkalian aljabar linier (bukan * biasa)
matrix_X <- Leontief_Inverse %*% fd

#validasi total_output_baru (matrix X) = total_output io
total_output_io <- io[1:jml_sektor,kolom_TOutput]
validasi_output <- matrix_X/total_output_io*100

# proposi fd terhadap output
fdProp <- fd/total_output_io
fdProp[is.nan(fdProp) | is.infinite(fdProp)] <- 0

#validasi Proporsi NTB/total input * (I - A)^-1 %*% FD = total input primer di IO
totInputPrimer <- as.numeric(io[baris_totInputPrimer,kolom_Sektor])
totInput <- as.numeric(io[baris_totInput,kolom_Sektor])
ntbProp <- totInputPrimer/totInput
ntbProp[is.nan(ntbProp) | is.infinite(ntbProp)] <- 0
matrix_X <- as.numeric(matrix_X)
kali_NTB <- as.numeric(matrix_X * ntbProp)
validasi_NtbProp <- kali_NTB/totInputPrimer*100

#validasi Proporsi NTB/total input * (I - A)^-1 %*% FD = pdrb di IO (NTB + pajak atas produk)
totInputPrimer <- as.numeric(io[baris_totInputPrimer,kolom_Sektor])
pdrb_IO <- totInputPrimer 

#validasi (I - A)^-1 %*% FD %*% Proporsi NTB/total input *= pdrb di IO (NTB + pajak atas produk)
validasi_PDRB_IO <- 100 - (kali_NTB/pdrb_IO*100)
validasi_PDRB_IO[is.nan(validasi_PDRB_IO) | is.infinite(validasi_PDRB_IO)] <- 0
mean(validasi_PDRB_IO)




# ==============================================================================
# MENGHITUNG Backward dan Forward Linkage
# ==============================================================================
# Direct Backward Linkage (DBL)  (Penjumlahan Kolom Matriks A)
dbl <- colSums(A_prov)
# Total Backward Linkage (TBL)  = Sum per Kolom pada Invers Leontief
tbl <- colSums(Leontief_Inverse)
# Indeks Total Backward Linkage (ITBL) / Indeks Daya Penyebaran Total (IDP)
itbl <- tbl / mean(tbl)

# Direct Forward Linkage (DFL)  (Penjumlahan Baris Matriks A)
dfl <- rowSums(A_prov)
# Total Forward Linkage (TFL)  = Sum per Baris pada Invers Leontief
tfl <- rowSums(Leontief_Inverse)
# Indeks Total Forward Linkage (ITFL) / Indeks Derajat Kepekaan Total (IDK)
itfl <- tfl / mean(tfl)


tabel_linkage <- data.frame(
  id_Sektor = kolom_Sektor,
  nama_Sektor  = namaSektor,
  TBL = round(tbl, 4),
  TFL = round(tfl, 4),
  ITBL = round(itbl, 4),
  ITFL = round(itfl, 4)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PENGELOMPOKAN KE DALAM 4 KUADRAN SEKTOR EKONOMI
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# masih menerapkan nilai 1, belum tau landasan pemilihan benchmarknya

tabel_kuadran <- tabel_linkage %>%
  mutate(
    Kuadran = case_when(
      ITBL > 1 & ITFL > 1  ~ "K1 (BL Tinggi, FL Tinggi)",
      ITBL > 1 & ITFL <= 1 ~ "K2 (BL Tinggi, FL Rendah)",
      ITBL <= 1 & ITFL > 1 ~ "K3 (BL Rendah, FL Tinggi)",
      TRUE               ~ "K4 (BL Rendah, FL Rendah)"
    ),
    Kategori = case_when(
      ITBL > 1 & ITFL > 1  ~ "Sektor Kunci (Key Sector)",
      ITBL > 1 & ITFL <= 1 ~ "Sektor Pendorong Hulu (Backward-Oriented)",
      ITBL <= 1 & ITFL > 1 ~ "Sektor Pendukung Hilir (Forward-Oriented)",
      TRUE               ~ "Sektor Lemah / Terisolasi (Weak Sector)"
    )
  )

# Menampilkan rekapitulasi jumlah sektor per kuadran
rekap_kuadran <- tabel_kuadran %>%
  group_by(Kuadran, Kategori) %>%
  summarise(Jumlah_Sektor = n(), .groups = "drop")
print("--- RINGKASAN JUMLAH SEKTOR PER KUADRAN ---")
print(rekap_kuadran)

# Menampilkan daftar Sektor Kunci (Kuadran 1)
sektor_kunci1 <- tabel_kuadran %>%
  filter(Kuadran == "K1 (BL Tinggi, FL Tinggi)")
print("--- DAFTAR SEKTOR KUNCI (KUADRAN 1) ---")
print(sektor_kunci1)

# Urutkan sektor berdasarkan ITBL tertinggi ke terendah
sektor_kunci1 <- sektor_kunci1[order(-sektor_kunci1$ITBL), ]

# Menampilkan daftar Sektor Kunci (Kuadran 2)
sektor_kunci2 <- tabel_kuadran %>%
  filter(Kuadran == "K2 (BL Tinggi, FL Rendah)")
print("--- DAFTAR SEKTOR KUNCI (KUADRAN 2) ---")
print(sektor_kunci2)

# Menampilkan daftar Sektor Kunci (Kuadran 3)
sektor_kunci3 <- tabel_kuadran %>%
  filter(Kuadran == "K3 (BL Rendah, FL Tinggi)")
print("--- DAFTAR SEKTOR KUNCI (KUADRAN 3) ---")
print(sektor_kunci3)

# Menampilkan daftar Sektor Kunci (Kuadran 4)
sektor_kunci4 <- tabel_kuadran %>%
  filter(Kuadran == "K4 (BL Rendah, FL Rendah)")
print("--- DAFTAR SEKTOR KUNCI (KUADRAN 4) ---")
print(sektor_kunci4)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VISUALISASI DIAGRAM KUADRAN (PLOT SCATTER)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(tabel_kuadran, aes(x = ITBL, y = ITFL, label = nama_Sektor)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Kuadran), size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.7, size = 2.5, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Diagram Kuadran Backward & Forward Linkage Sektor Ekonomi",
    subtitle = "Garis Merah Putus-putus Menunjukkan Batas Indeks = 1.00",
    x = "Indeks Total Backward Linkage (ITBL) / Indeks Daya Penyebaran (IDP)",
    y = "Indeks Total Forward Linkage (ITFL) / Indeks Derajat Kepekaan (IDK)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# ==============================================================================
# ANALISIS KSM (KLASIFIKASI SEKTOR MAKRO)
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ENGELOMPOKAN KSM PADA TINGKAT SEKTOR MIKRO
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Ekstraksi nama KSM dari Kolom D (Kolom ke-5) untuk 66 sektor
ksm_sektor <- io[1:jml_sektor, 5] #kategori berdasarkan 17 sektor besar, jika pakai 2 digit sektor pakai kolom no 4

# Menambahkan kolom KSM ke tabel_kuadran yang sudah Anda buat
tabel_kuadran_sektoral <- tabel_kuadran %>%
  mutate(KSM = ksm_sektor) %>%
  select(nama_Sektor, KSM, TBL, TFL, ITBL, ITFL, Kuadran, Kategori)

# A. Ringkasan Rata-rata Nilai Linkage per KSM
ringkasan_ksm_profil <- tabel_kuadran_sektoral %>%
  group_by(KSM) %>%
  summarise(
    Jumlah_Sektor = n(),
    Rata2_ITBL    = round(mean(ITBL), 4),
    Rata2_ITFL    = round(mean(ITFL), 4),
    .groups       = "drop"
  )

# B. Distribusi Penyebaran Kuadran (K1, K2, K3, K4) pada Tiap KSM
distribusi_kuadran_ksm <- tabel_kuadran_sektoral %>%
  count(KSM, Kuadran) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Kuadran, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

# C. Tabel Ringkasan Profil KSM
profil_ksm_lengkap <- left_join(ringkasan_ksm_profil, distribusi_kuadran_ksm, by = "KSM")

print("--- PROFIL RINGKASAN SEKTOR MIKRO DALAM KSM ---")
print(profil_ksm_lengkap)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AGREGASI MATRIKS I-O KE TINGKAT KSM (ANALYSIS MATRIKS MAKRO)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Mengidentifikasi daftar KSM Unik
ksm_unik <- unique(ksm_sektor)
n_ksm    <- length(ksm_unik)

# Membuat Matriks Pemetaan / Agregasi M (Ukuran: n_ksm x jml_sektor)
M <- matrix(0, nrow = n_ksm, ncol = jml_sektor)
rownames(M) <- ksm_unik
colnames(M) <- kolom_Sektor

for (i in 1:n_ksm) {
  M[i, ksm_sektor == ksm_unik[i]] <- 1
}

# Agregasi Matriks Transaksi (Z_ksm) dan Total Output (X_ksm)
Z_ksm <- M %*% Z_prov %*% t(M)
X_ksm <- as.vector(M %*% X_prov)

# Matriks Koefisien Teknis KSM (A_ksm = Z_ksm / X_ksm)
A_ksm <- sweep(Z_ksm, 2, X_ksm, FUN = "/")
A_ksm[is.nan(A_ksm) | is.infinite(A_ksm)] <- 0

# Matriks Invers Leontief KSM (Leontief_Inverse_ksm)
I_ksm <- diag(n_ksm)
I_minus_A_ksm <- I_ksm - A_ksm
Leontief_Inverse_ksm <- solve(I_minus_A_ksm)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MENGHITUNG BACKWARD & FORWARD LINKAGE untuk (KSM)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Total Backward & Forward Linkage Makro
tbl_ksm <- colSums(Leontief_Inverse_ksm)
tfl_ksm <- rowSums(Leontief_Inverse_ksm)

# Indeks Total Backward & Forward Linkage Makro (ITBL & ITFL)
itbl_ksm <- tbl_ksm / mean(tbl_ksm)
itfl_ksm <- tfl_ksm / mean(tfl_ksm)

# Membentuk Tabel Kuadran KSM Makro
tabel_kuadran_ksm <- data.frame(
  Nama_KSM     = ksm_unik,
  Total_Output = round(X_ksm, 2),
  TBL_Makro    = round(tbl_ksm, 4),
  TFL_Makro    = round(tfl_ksm, 4),
  ITBL_Makro   = round(itbl_ksm, 4),
  ITFL_Makro   = round(itfl_ksm, 4)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Kuadran = case_when(
      ITBL_Makro > 1 & ITFL_Makro > 1  ~ "K1 (BL Tinggi, FL Tinggi)",
      ITBL_Makro > 1 & ITFL_Makro <= 1 ~ "K2 (BL Tinggi, FL Rendah)",
      ITBL_Makro <= 1 & ITFL_Makro > 1 ~ "K3 (BL Rendah, FL Tinggi)",
      TRUE                             ~ "K4 (BL Rendah, FL Rendah)"
    ),
    Kategori = case_when(
      ITBL_Makro > 1 & ITFL_Makro > 1  ~ "Sektor Kunci (Key Sector)",
      ITBL_Makro > 1 & ITFL_Makro <= 1 ~ "Sektor Pendorong Hulu (Backward-Oriented)",
      ITBL_Makro <= 1 & ITFL_Makro > 1 ~ "Sektor Pendukung Hilir (Forward-Oriented)",
      TRUE                             ~ "Sektor Lemah / Terisolasi (Weak Sector)"
    )
  )

print("--- HASIL ANALISIS KUADRAN KSM MAKRO ---")
print(tabel_kuadran_ksm)



# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REKAPITULASI & SEKTOR KUNCI MAKRO (KSM)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Rekapitulasi Jumlah KSM per Kuadran
rekap_ksm <- tabel_kuadran_ksm %>%
  group_by(Kuadran, Kategori) %>%
  summarise(Jumlah_KSM = n(), .groups = "drop")

print("--- RINGKASAN JUMLAH KSM PER KUADRAN ---")
print(rekap_ksm)

# Tampilkan Daftar KSM Kunci (Kuadran 1 Makro)
ksm_kunci1 <- tabel_kuadran_ksm %>% filter(Kuadran == "K1 (BL Tinggi, FL Tinggi)")
print("--- DAFTAR SEKTOR MAKRO KUNCI (K1-KSM) ---")
print(ksm_kunci1)

# Tampilkan Daftar KSM Kunci (Kuadran 1 Makro)
ksm_kunci2 <- tabel_kuadran_ksm %>% filter(Kuadran == "K2 (BL Tinggi, FL Rendah)")
print("--- DAFTAR SEKTOR MAKRO KUNCI (K2-KSM) ---")
print(ksm_kunci2)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VISUALISASI DIAGRAM KUADRAN KSM MAKRO (PLOT SCATTER)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(tabel_kuadran_ksm, aes(x = ITBL_Makro, y = ITFL_Makro, label = Nama_KSM)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Kuadran, size = Total_Output), alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.8, size = 3, fontface = "bold", check_overlap = FALSE) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Total Output (Rp)", labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Diagram Kuadran Klasifikasi Sektor Makro (KSM)",
    subtitle = "Garis Merah Putus-putus Menunjukkan Batas Benchmark Indeks = 1.00",
    x = "Indeks Total Backward Linkage (ITBL) / Indeks Daya Penyebaran (IDP)",
    y = "Indeks Total Forward Linkage (ITFL) / Indeks Derajat Kepekaan (IDK)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")



# ==============================================================================
# MENGHITUNG MULTIPLIERS (OUTPUT, INCOME, LABOUR, IMPORT)
# TINGKAT SEKTORAL DAN RATA-RATA KSM (SEKTOR MAKRO)
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PERSIAPAN DATA KOEFISIEN INPUT PRIMER
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Catatan: Sesuaikan indeks baris pada file IO Anda jika berbeda.
baris_upah  <- 70  # Baris Kompensasi Tenaga Kerja / Gaji & Upah
baris_impor <- 69  # Baris Impor / Input Luar Daerah


# A. Koefisien Pendapatan Langsung (h)
upah_gaji <- as.numeric(io[baris_upah, kolom_Sektor])
upah_gaji[is.na(upah_gaji)] <- 0
h <- upah_gaji / X_prov
h[is.nan(h) | is.infinite(h)] <- 0
h_diag <- diag(h)

# B. Koefisien Tenaga Kerja Langsung (w)
tk_prov <- as.numeric(tkSektor_prov[, "BUKECAP"])
tk_prov[is.na(tk_prov)] <- 0
w <- tk_prov / X_prov
w[is.nan(w) | is.infinite(w)] <- 0
w_diag <- diag(w)

# C. Koefisien Impor Langsung (m)
impor <- as.numeric(io[baris_impor, kolom_Sektor])
impor[is.na(impor)] <- 0
im <- impor / X_prov
im[is.nan(im) | is.infinite(im)] <- 0
im_diag <- diag(im)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PERHITUNGAN MULTIPLIER & EFFECT LEVEL 66 SEKTOR (SEKTORAL)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) Output Multiplier (Pengganda Output)
output_mult <- colSums(Leontief_Inverse) # sama dengan TBL

# 2) Income Multiplier & Effect (Pendapatan)
income_effect <- h_diag %*% Leontief_Inverse
# income_mult <- colSums(income_effect) #sama dengan income multiplier di excel 

# 3) Labour Multiplier & Effect (Tenaga Kerja)
labour_effect <- w_diag %*% Leontief_Inverse
# labour_mult   <- colSums(labour_effect)

# 4) Import Multiplier & Effect (Kebocoran Impor)
import_effect <- im_diag %*% Leontief_Inverse
# import_mult   <- colSums(import_effect)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PERHITUNGAN DAMPAK TOTAL (EFFECTS) & MULTIPLIER TIPE I
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A. Dampak Total (Total Effects per 1 unit Permintaan Akhir)
tot_income_effect <- as.vector(colSums(h_diag %*% Leontief_Inverse))   # Total Income Effect (Rp/Rp)
tot_labour_effect <- as.vector(colSums(w_diag %*% Leontief_Inverse))   # Total Labour Effect (Orang/Rp)
tot_import_effect <- as.vector(colSums(im_diag %*% Leontief_Inverse))  # Total Import Effect (Kebocoran)

# B. Multiplier Tipe I (Rasio Kelipatan terhadap Koefisien Langsung)
type1_income_mult <- ifelse(h > 0, tot_income_effect / h, 0)
type1_labour_mult <- ifelse(w > 0, tot_labour_effect / w, 0)
type1_import_mult <- ifelse(im > 0, tot_import_effect / im, 0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PENGGABUNGAN KE TABEL KUADRAN SEKTORAL (66 SEKTOR MIKRO)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Menggabungkan Hasil Multiplier Sektoral ke Tabel Kuadran Sektoral
tabel_multiplier_sektoral <- tabel_kuadran_sektoral %>%
  mutate(
    # Koefisien Langsung (Input Primer per Unit Output)
    Koef_Upah_h          = round(h, 6),
    Koef_TK_w            = round(w, 6),
    Koef_Impor_m         = round(im, 6),
    
    # Pengganda Output
    Output_Multiplier    = round(output_mult, 4),
    
    # Dampak Total (Total Effects)
    Income_Effect        = round(tot_income_effect, 4),
    Labour_Effect        = round(tot_labour_effect, 4),
    Import_Effect        = round(tot_import_effect, 4),
    
    # Multiplier Tipe I (Kelipatan)
    Income_Multiplier_T1 = round(type1_income_mult, 4),
    Labour_Multiplier_T1 = round(type1_labour_mult, 4),
    Import_Multiplier_T1 = round(type1_import_mult, 4)
  )

print("--- 10 SEKTOR MIKRO PERTAMA DENGAN TABEL MULTIPLIER LENGKAP ---")
print(head(tabel_multiplier_sektoral, 10))



# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ANALISIS RATA-RATA MULTIPLIER TINGKAT KSM (SEKTOR MAKRO)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

tabel_multiplier_ksm_rerata <- tabel_multiplier_sektoral %>%
  group_by(KSM) %>%
  summarise(
    Jumlah_Sektor          = n(),
    Rata2_ITBL             = round(mean(ITBL), 4),
    Rata2_ITFL             = round(mean(ITFL), 4),
    Rata2_Output_Mult      = round(mean(Output_Multiplier), 4),
    Rata2_Income_Effect    = round(mean(Income_Effect), 4),
    Rata2_Labour_Effect    = round(mean(Labour_Effect), 4),
    Rata2_Import_Effect    = round(mean(Import_Effect), 4),
    Rata2_Income_Mult_T1   = round(mean(Income_Multiplier_T1), 4),
    Rata2_Labour_Mult_T1   = round(mean(Labour_Multiplier_T1), 4),
    Rata2_Import_Mult_T1   = round(mean(Import_Multiplier_T1), 4),
    .groups                = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Kuadran_KSM = case_when(
      Rata2_ITBL > 1 & Rata2_ITFL > 1  ~ "K1 (Sektor Kunci)",
      Rata2_ITBL > 1 & Rata2_ITFL <= 1 ~ "K2 (Pendorong Hulu)",
      Rata2_ITBL <= 1 & Rata2_ITFL > 1 ~ "K3 (Pendukung Hilir)",
      TRUE                             ~ "K4 (Terisolasi/Lemah)"
    )
  )

print("--- RATA-RATA MULTIPLIER TINGKAT KSM MAKRO ---")
print(tabel_multiplier_ksm_rerata)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IDENTIFIKASI SEKTOR & KSM STRATEGIS WILAYAH
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Kriteria Sektor/KSM Strategis:
# 1. Berada di Kuadran 1 (ITBL > 1 & ITFL > 1) ATAU Kuadran 2 (ITBL > 1)
# 2. Memiliki Rata-Rata Output Multiplier DI ATAS Rata-Rata Perekonomian
# 3. Memiliki Kebocoran Impor (Import Effect) DI BAWAH Rata-Rata Perekonomian

mean_out_gen <- mean(tabel_multiplier_sektoral$Output_Multiplier)
mean_imp_gen <- mean(tabel_multiplier_sektoral$Import_Effect)

# Identifikasi Sektor Mikro Strategis
sektor_strategis <- tabel_multiplier_sektoral %>%
  filter(
    ITBL > 1, # Daya tarik hulu kuat
    Output_Multiplier >= mean_out_gen, # Pengganda output tinggi
    Import_Effect <= mean_imp_gen      # Kebocoran impor rendah
  ) %>%
  select(nama_Sektor, KSM, ITBL, ITFL, Kuadran, Output_Multiplier, Income_Effect, Labour_Effect, Import_Effect)

print("--- DAFTAR SEKTOR MIKRO STRATEGIS WILAYAH ---")
print(sektor_strategis)

# Sektor Berbasis Lahan (Land-Based Sectors)
sektor_lahan <- tabel_multiplier_sektoral %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(KSM) & grepl("Pertanian|Kehutanan|Perkebunan|Peternakan|Perikanan|Padi|Tanaman", KSM, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )

print("--- DAFTAR SEKTOR BERBASIS LAHAN ---")
print(sektor_lahan %>% select(nama_Sektor, KSM, Kuadran, Output_Multiplier, Income_Effect, Labour_Effect, Import_Effect))

# Identifikasi KSM Makro Strategis
ksm_strategis <- tabel_multiplier_ksm_rerata %>%
  filter(
    Rata2_ITBL > 1,# Daya tarik hulu kuat
    Rata2_Output_Mult >= mean(Rata2_Output_Mult)# Pengganda output tinggi
  )

print("--- DAFTAR KSM MAKRO STRATEGIS WILAYAH ---")
print(ksm_strategis)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IDENTIFIKASI SEKTOR STRATEGIS BERBASIS LAHAN (LAND-BASED SECTORS)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Filter Sektor Berbasis Lahan (Pertanian, Kehutanan, Perkebunan, Peternakan, Perikanan)
sektor_lahan <- tabel_multiplier_sektoral %>%
  filter(!is.na(KSM) & grepl("Pertanian|Kehutanan|Perkebunan|Peternakan|Perikanan", KSM, ignore.case = TRUE) ) %>%
  select(nama_Sektor, KSM, ITBL, ITFL, Kuadran, Output_Multiplier, Income_Effect, Labour_Effect, Import_Effect)

print("--- ANALISIS KHUSUS SEKTOR BERBASIS LAHAN ---")
print(sektor_lahan)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VISUALISASI DIAGRAM KUADRAN (PLOT SCATTER)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(sektor_lahan, aes(x = ITBL, y = ITFL, label = nama_Sektor)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Kuadran), size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.7, size = 2.5, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Diagram Kuadran Backward & Forward Linkage Sektor Ekonomi - Sektor Lahan",
    subtitle = "Garis Merah Putus-putus Menunjukkan Batas Indeks = 1.00",
    x = "Indeks Total Backward Linkage (ITBL) / Indeks Daya Penyebaran (IDP)",
    y = "Indeks Total Forward Linkage (ITFL) / Indeks Derajat Kepekaan (IDK)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
